title: Oswald infiltrates Free Cuba group and is arrested in New Orleans

tellings.quote: He he infiltrated the group. That was when he got arrested on the street, remember?

plain: In New Orleans in 1963, Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of killing President John F. Kennedy later that year, worked his way inside a Free Cuba group, a movement opposed to Cuba's government, and was then arrested on the street. A researcher named Dan Sheehan tells Michels this from his own knowledge, without naming a source: "He infiltrated the group. That was when he got arrested on the street, remember?" Sheehan raises it as a sign that Oswald was working for someone rather than acting alone.
